description:
A week-long international radio digging journey, stopping by some of our favourite record stores in the world, to nerd out about the music they love and sell, and play the sounds that made them famous. 
✈ London ✈ Tokyo ✈ Lagos ✈ New York ✈ Rio ✈ Paris ✈ Wellington
